So 10 liters = 10 / 3.78541 ≈ 2.64172 gallons. But we need to fill up the tank. The user says "Please go ahead and fill up the tank". That implies fill to full capacity. So we need to fill 50 gallons minus current. But we don't know current gallons. We have 10 liters. Convert to gallons: 10 / 3.78541 = 2.6417 gallons. So we need to add 50 - 2.6417 = 47.3583 gallons. But the function expects fuelAmount in gallons. So we call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount ~47.36 gallons. Let's do that.

The tank capacity is 50 gallons. We have 10 liters. Need to convert to gallons. 1 gallon = 3.78541 liters. So 10 liters = 10 / 3.78541 ≈ 2.64172 gallons. But we need to fill up the tank. The user says "Please go ahead and fill up the tank". That implies fill to full capacity. So we need to fill 50 gallons minus current. But we don\'t know current gallons. We have 10 liters. Convert to gallons: 10 / 3.78541 = 2.6417 gallons. So we need to add 50 - 2.6417 = 47.3583 gallons. But the function expects fuelAmount in gallons. So we call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount ~47.36 gallons. Let\'s do that.')
